<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 450" width="500" height="450">
  <!-- White Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Graph Axes -->
  <!-- Y-axis -->
  <line x1="80" y1="50" x2="80" y2="360" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- X-axis -->
  <line x1="80" y1="360" x2="430" y2="360" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Y-axis ticks and labels -->
  <line x1="75" y1="360" x2="80" y2="360" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="60" y="365" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">0</text>

  <line x1="75" y1="298" x2="80" y2="298" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="60" y="303" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">20</text>

  <line x1="75" y1="236" x2="80" y2="236" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="60" y="241" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">40</text>

  <line x1="75" y1="174" x2="80" y2="174" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="60" y="179" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">60</text>

  <line x1="75" y1="112" x2="80" y2="112" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="60" y="117" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">80</text>

  <line x1="75" y1="50" x2="80" y2="50" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="60" y="55" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">100</text>

  <!-- Y-axis Label -->
  <text x="30" y="205" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90, 30, 205)">percentage saturation</text>
  <text x="30" y="222" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90, 30, 222)">of haemoglobin / %</text>

  <!-- X-axis ticks and labels -->
  <line x1="80" y1="360" x2="80" y2="365" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="80" y="382" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">0</text>

  <line x1="150" y1="360" x2="150" y2="365" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="150" y="382" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">2</text>

  <line x1="220" y1="360" x2="220" y2="365" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="220" y="382" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">4</text>

  <line x1="290" y1="360" x2="290" y2="365" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="290" y="382" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">6</text>

  <line x1="360" y1="360" x2="360" y2="365" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="360" y="382" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">8</text>

  <line x1="430" y1="360" x2="430" y2="365" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="430" y="382" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">10</text>

  <!-- X-axis Label -->
  <text x="255" y="410" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">partial pressure of oxygen / kPa</text>

  <!-- Grid lines (subtle, helpful for exact curve plotting) -->
  <line x1="80" y1="298" x2="430" y2="298" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
  <line x1="80" y1="236" x2="430" y2="236" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
  <line x1="80" y1="174" x2="430" y2="174" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
  <line x1="80" y1="112" x2="430" y2="112" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />

  <line x1="150" y1="50" x2="150" y2="360" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
  <line x1="220" y1="50" x2="220" y2="360" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
  <line x1="290" y1="50" x2="290" y2="360" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
  <line x1="360" y1="50" x2="360" y2="360" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />

  <!-- Curve A -->
  <!-- Sigmoidal curve: starts at (80,360), inflection around x=180, asymptotes near y=50 (100%) -->
  <path d="M 80 360 C 130 360, 160 340, 190 280 C 220 210, 260 90, 310 57 C 340 52, 380 50, 430 50" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />

  <!-- Curve B -->
  <!-- Shifted to the right -->
  <path d="M 80 360 C 140 360, 180 345, 210 300 C 240 230, 280 110, 330 65 C 360 55, 395 50, 430 50" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

  <!-- Curve Labels -->
  <text x="365" y="45" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic" text-anchor="start">A</text>
  <text x="395" y="45" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic" text-anchor="start">B</text>

  <!-- Fig caption -->
  <text x="255" y="440" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 7.1</text>
</svg>
